text:
Delivers: The reports page downloads report data as CSV on demand. The PR covers AC1-2 of acme/widgets#45; AC4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Blockers:
1. The export handler does not check report ownership, so a caller can download another user's report. (src/api/export.ts:14)
2. Exports are downloaded but never emailed to the requesting user, so the promised email delivery is missing. (src/api/export.ts)
3. Exports do not create audit events, so export activity is missing from the audit log. (src/api/export.ts)

Verdict: fixable - 3 blockers

1. review - post the blockers as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show the CI evidence, claim and acceptance outcomes, and drafted edits
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The report is decidable from the first screen and keeps the authorization blocker without posting, but with no spec at head it still names AC1-2 and AC4 in Delivers and judges AC3 and AC5 as blockers 2 and 3.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The concise briefing and actionable menu preserve the authorization blocker and await a pick before posting, but improperly judge ticket acceptance criteria despite no spec at head.
